objective.text: Distinguish a circuit breaker's open state from a per-request retry loop.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish rejecting a call during an open interval from retrying that call downstream.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: This is application policy code, not a built-in Laravel circuit-breaker API. The shared breaker is open until monotonic time 5000 ms. A request arrives at 4200 ms.

files.source:
<?php

function mayCall(int $nowMs, int $openUntilMs): bool
{
    return $nowMs >= $openUntilMs;
}

$attempts = 0;
if (mayCall(4200, 5000)) {
    $attempts++;
}
echo $attempts;

stem: With the shown policy, how many downstream attempts does that request make?

options.text: One, because every request must test whether the service has recovered.
options.rationale: This policy does not admit a probe before openUntil; recovery probing belongs to a later state or explicit policy.
options.misconception: This policy does not admit a probe before openUntil; recovery probing belongs to a later state or explicit policy.

options.text: Three, because an open circuit increases the retry count.
options.rationale: The shown open-state gate prevents calls; it does not define or increase a retry count.
options.misconception: The shown open-state gate prevents calls; it does not define or increase a retry count.

options.rationale: The open interval has not expired, so this policy rejects the downstream call before any per-request retry loop could run.

options.text: A random count determined by Laravel’s queue attempts setting.
options.rationale: This synchronous application gate does not consult queue attempt settings.
options.misconception: This synchronous application gate does not consult queue attempt settings.
